log.title: Console
log.empty: Nothing logged yet. Start a run and every step the plugin takes shows up here.
log.noMatches: No lines match the current filters.
log.footer: Every line also goes to the Dalamud log (/xllog) with the {0} prefix. When reporting a bug, press Copy log and paste the result into the issue.
log.copyTooltip: Copies the lines shown below with a header naming the plugin version, Dalamud version and zone, ready to paste into a bug report.
log.levelTooltip: Click to show or hide these lines. Shift-click to show only this level.
log.sourceChipTooltip: Click to stop filtering by source.
log.shortcuts: Ctrl+F search · Ctrl+C copy · Shift-click selects a range · Double-click copies a line
log.copyToEnd: Copy from here to the end
log.hasDetails: Has a stack trace. Select the line to read it.
changelog.title: What's new
changelog.subtitle: Every update, newest first.
changelog.r1000.1: A new window with three pages, Find a home, My lottery and Saved, that fill in as the housing features arrive
changelog.r1000.2: The Plugins page lists Lifestream, the helper that travels to a plot, with a one-click install
changelog.r1000.3: Settings for the window, the language and the GM alert, and a Console page that copies a ready-made bug report
changelog.r1000.4: Nine languages, picked from your Dalamud and game client settings on first launch
about.support.title: Made with love and care
about.support.body: This plugin is a one-person project, built in my free time because I love this game and its community. Keeping it updated takes a lot of those hours. If it has helped you, supporting me on Patreon or buying me a coffee means I can keep giving it that time. Thank you for being here.
about.support.coffeeHint: Open Buy Me a Coffee · right-click to copy
about.linkHint: Click to open · right-click to copy
about.discordBody: Get help, report bugs, share ideas and hear about updates first.
about.githubBody: Browse the source code and every release.
about.reminder.title: A little reminder
about.facts.title: Did you know?
about.quotes.title: Words to live by
about.jokes.title: Just for fun
about.reminder.1: Been at it a while? Roll your shoulders and take one slow breath.
about.reminder.2: Hydration check. When did you last drink some water?
about.reminder.3: Blink a few times and let your eyes rest for a moment.
about.reminder.4: Stand up, stretch, and shake out your hands. Future you says thanks.
about.reminder.5: Sit up and settle in comfortably. Your back will thank you later.
about.reminder.6: Remember to eat something today. You matter more than any score.
about.reminder.7: Eyes feel tired? Look at something far away for twenty seconds.
about.reminder.8: Whatever you're chasing, you're allowed to take a break whenever.
about.reminder.9: You're doing great. Be a little kinder to yourself today.
about.reminder.10: A glass of water and a quick stretch can reset a long session.
about.reminder.11: Unclench your jaw and drop your shoulders. There you go.
about.reminder.12: Rest is part of the journey too. Step away whenever you need to.
about.facts.1: Honey never spoils. Jars over 3,000 years old have been found still edible.
about.facts.2: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
about.facts.3: A day on Venus is longer than a whole year on Venus.
about.facts.4: Bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't.
about.facts.5: There are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe.
about.facts.6: Sharks have been around longer than trees have.
about.facts.7: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
about.facts.8: Honeybees can recognize individual human faces.
about.facts.10: The Eiffel Tower can grow over 15 cm taller on a hot day.
about.facts.11: Hot water can sometimes freeze faster than cold water.
about.facts.12: A bolt of lightning is roughly five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
about.quotes.1: Done is better than perfect. You can always polish later.
about.quotes.2: Small steps every day add up to surprising distances.
about.quotes.3: Comparison is the thief of joy. Run your own race.
about.quotes.5: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
about.quotes.6: Be patient with yourself. Growth takes time.
about.quotes.7: The best time to begin was yesterday. The second best is right now.
about.quotes.8: Celebrate the small wins. They count too.
about.quotes.10: Your only real competition is who you were yesterday.
about.jokes.1: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.
about.jokes.2: I would tell you a chemistry joke, but I know I wouldn't get a reaction.
about.jokes.3: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
about.jokes.4: I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. It's impossible to put down.
about.jokes.5: Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts.
about.jokes.6: What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
about.jokes.7: Why did the bicycle fall over? It was two tired.
about.jokes.8: What do you call cheese that isn't yours? Nacho cheese.
about.jokes.9: I'm on a seafood diet. I see food, and I eat it.
about.jokes.10: I only know 25 letters of the alphabet. I don't know y.
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: The language of this plugin's windows. World, district and zone names always follow the game client.
settings.general.openOnLoginHelp: Pop the main window automatically the next time you log in.
settings.general.autoPauseHelp: Pause the run while you are inside a duty, trial, raid, or any other instanced content, then resume it once you are back outside.
settings.general.pauseTypingHelp: While a text box of the game has focus, like the chat line, a run starts no new move until you close it. A move already under way carries on.
plugin.commandHelp: Toggle the Auto House Lottery window. /autohouselottery config | lottery | saved | deps | log | changelog | about | stop | pause | resume | target (dump the current target's BaseId) | probe (log every housing reading for this spot).
plugin.configReset: Your settings could not be read, so Auto House Lottery started with default settings. The old file is kept as {0}.
plugin.configResetUnsaved: Your settings could not be read, so Auto House Lottery started with default settings. The old file could not be kept; the log has the details.
safety.tabSub: Detects nearby Game Masters and reacts: stop the run, ping you, or take more drastic action.
safety.gm.stopRunHelp: End the run at once when a GM appears nearby. Strongly recommended; the other alerts are little use if the run keeps going.
safety.gm.toastHelp: Pop a Dalamud toast: "GM <name> is nearby!"
safety.gm.chatHelp: Print a red chat warning into your local log.
safety.gm.soundHelp: Plays a series of system beeps through your speakers. Loud enough to grab your attention if you're tabbed away.
safety.gm.beepCountHelp: How many beeps to play in the burst.
safety.gm.commandsHelp: Chat commands to run when a GM is spotted. Useful for things like /logout, /sh stay calm, or a macro.
safety.gm.killHelp: Hard-terminate the game process via /xlkill. The last-resort option; no goodbyes, no cutscene, no logout. You'll get a disconnect.
probe.done: Housing readings written to the Console (/ahl log).
probe.started: Probe task started; follow it in the Console (/ahl log).
probe.failed: The probe could not start; the Console (/ahl log) says why.
probe.usage: Usage: /ahl probe [scan | lottery | goto <district> <ward> <plot> | approach <ward> <plot> | press <enter | results | cancel | no> | stop]
run.title: Entering lottery · Character {0} of {1}
run.enteredBody: {0} is entered for {1}. My lottery keeps the receipt.
run.dryRunBody: At the confirmation for {0}, the run would have entered for {1}. It closed the confirmation instead and nothing was paid.
run.dryRunGilMoved: Your gil changed while the confirmation was open. Check the Console before trusting this dry run.
run.uncertainBody: The game may have accepted the entry, but the plugin could not confirm it. Retry entry stays unavailable until your lottery entry has been read back.
runFailure.sold: The plot is no longer for sale.
runFailure.wrongPhase: The plot is not taking entries right now.
runFailure.notLottery: The plot is sold first come, first served, not by lottery.
runFailure.changedPrice: The plot's deposit changed since you chose it.
runFailure.overBudget: The deposit is more than this character's limit or gil allows.
runFailure.ineligible: This plot is for a different buyer type.
runFailure.travelFailed: Travel did not reach the plot.
runFailure.travelUnavailable: Travel needs Lifestream. Install it, or walk to the plot yourself.
runFailure.dependencyBusy: Lifestream is busy with something else.
runFailure.wrongDestination: The character is not in the plot's ward.
runFailure.placardNotFound: The plot's placard could not be found nearby.
runFailure.placardNotOpened: The plot's placard did not open.
runFailure.wrongPlacard: The open placard belongs to another plot.
runFailure.identityUnverified: The placard's address could not be confirmed.
runFailure.saleUnreadable: The placard's sale details could not be read.
runFailure.entryButtonUnavailable: The placard offers no lottery entry to this character.
runFailure.confirmationNotShown: The lottery confirmation did not appear.
runFailure.depositUnreadable: The deposit on the lottery confirmation could not be read.
runFailure.gilUnknown: This character's gil could not be read.
runFailure.checkboxNotTicked: The confirmation's checkbox could not be ticked. Nothing was submitted.
runFailure.confirmRefused: Confirm could not be pressed. Nothing was submitted.
runFailure.realEntryNotCovered: This entry is not covered by the real-entry permission. Nothing was submitted.
runFailure.characterIneligible: This character cannot enter this lottery.
runFailure.alreadyEntered: This character already has an entry this lottery period.
runFailure.collectRefundFirst: Collect refund first. The game refuses a new entry until an earlier refund is collected.
runFailure.checkEarlierResult: Check your earlier entry's result first. Its deposit is still held.
runFailure.unclaimedWin: You won an earlier lottery. Claim that plot or give it up before entering again.
runFailure.cycleChanged: A new lottery period began during the run.
runFailure.journalUnavailable: Entries cannot be recorded right now, so none is made.
runFailure.characterChanged: A different character is logged in.
runFailure.inspectionsExhausted: No plot on the shortlist passed its live checks.
runFailure.submissionUncertain: The entry's outcome is not known yet.
runFailure.rejected.oneEntry: The game says this character already has an entry this lottery period.
runFailure.rejected.outstanding: The game says an earlier refund or plot must be collected first.
runFailure.rejected.landOwned: The game says this account already owns land on this world.
runFailure.rejected.caretaker: The game says the caretaker still holds items for you.
runFailure.rejected.demolition: The game says land cannot be bought right after an automatic demolition.
runFailure.rejected.membership: The game says a free company plot needs 30 days of membership.
runFailure.rejected.actionFailed: The game could not complete the housing action. Try again later.
runFailure.rejected.leftCompany: The game says this character no longer belongs to that free company.
runStart.alreadyRunning: A run is already in progress.
runStart.busy: Another task is using the game.
runStart.notLoggedIn: Log in to a character first.
runStart.wrongMode: This plan does not match the button used.
runStart.characterNotInPolicy: The logged-in character is not part of this plan.
runStart.journalUnavailable: Entries cannot be recorded right now.
runStart.reconciliationPending: An earlier entry is still being checked.
runStart.alreadyEntered: This character already has an entry this lottery period.
runStart.entryPeriodClosed: The lottery is not taking entries right now.
runStart.noAssignment: No plot in this plan can be entered by this character.
runStart.multipleWins: Confirm first that only one win can be claimed.
reconcile.notHomeWorld: Return to your home world, then check again.
reconcile.notRead: Your lottery entry could not be read. Try again in a moment.
reconcile.stillUncertain: Your lottery entry does not show yet whether it completed.
dev.usage: Usage: /ahl dev [run <district> <ward> <plot> <deposit> [fc] | allow-real-entry <character name> <district> <ward> <plot> <max gil> | revoke-real-entry]
dev.dryRunStarted: Dry run started for {0} at {1}. It stops at the lottery confirmation and closes it.
dev.realRunStarted: REAL ENTRY run started for {0} at {1}. Watch it; /ahl stop stops it before Confirm.
dev.grantWarning: REAL ENTRY ALLOWED for this session only: {0} may enter {1} once, for at most {2}. The next run on that plot deposits real gil and cannot be undone. /ahl dev revoke-real-entry withdraws it.
dev.grantRefused: Not allowed: name the logged-in character, a district, a ward, a plot on its home world and a gil ceiling above zero.
dev.revoked: Real entry permission withdrawn. Every run is a dry run again.
